description:
A romance only works when each person risks being seen before they are sure the other will catch them. That is the argument this breakdown of Trust Fall by Lynn Painter sets out to prove.

We follow Julia, a Nebraska woman whose long relationship has just ended, and Damen, the New York heir whose family is fighting over money and reputation. The story turns on one scene: Damen hanging from the white lattice trellis outside Julia's childhood home in the rain, dropping his guard to ask, "I wasn't ready yet, Jules. Were you?"

We also test the book's weakest point, where the romance strains and a reader can push back.
